definition_en: existing in large quantities; more than enough
example_en: The region has abundant supplies of fresh water.
example_id: Wilayah itu memiliki pasokan air tawar yang melimpah.

definition_en: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement
example_en: The union negotiated a shorter working week.
example_id: Serikat pekerja menegosiasikan minggu kerja yang lebih pendek.

definition_en: no longer needed for a job and therefore dismissed
example_en: Hundreds of factory workers were made redundant last year.
example_id: Ratusan pekerja pabrik terkena PHK tahun lalu.

definition_en: to travel regularly between home and work
definition_id: pulang pergi; bepergian rutin ke tempat kerja
example_en: She commutes two hours every day by train.
example_id: Dia pulang pergi dua jam setiap hari dengan kereta.

definition_en: a planned list of places to visit on a journey
example_en: Our guide changed the itinerary because of the rain.
example_id: Pemandu kami mengubah rencana perjalanan karena hujan.

definition_en: historic buildings and traditions that a society preserves
example_en: The old town is protected as world heritage.
example_id: Kota tua itu dilindungi sebagai warisan dunia.

definition_en: the subjects that students study at a school
example_en: Maths and science are core parts of the national curriculum.
example_id: Matematika dan sains adalah bagian inti kurikulum nasional.

definition_en: copying someone else's work and pretending it is yours
example_en: The university expelled him for plagiarism.

definition_en: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
example_en: The app uses an algorithm to recommend videos.
example_id: Aplikasi itu memakai algoritme untuk merekomendasikan video.

definition_en: to change data into a secret code to protect it
example_en: Banks encrypt customer data before storing it.
example_id: Bank mengenkripsi data nasabah sebelum menyimpannya.

definition_en: able to continue without harming nature
example_en: Solar power is a sustainable source of energy.
example_id: Tenaga surya adalah sumber energi yang berkelanjutan.

definition_en: a disease that spreads quickly to many people
example_en: The city prepared hospitals during the flu epidemic.
example_id: Kota itu menyiapkan rumah sakit selama epidemi flu.

definition_en: practices that keep people clean and healthy
example_en: Good hygiene helps prevent the spread of disease.
example_id: Kebersihan yang baik membantu mencegah penyebaran penyakit.
